title: The Placeholder Lodge
intro: A test fixture, not the real case. Storm outside, a body in the snug, two suspects at the bar.

acts.name: Closing Time
acts.intro: The landlord is dead in the snug. Nobody may leave until the road clears.

acts.name: After Hours
acts.intro: The power flickers. Stories start to come apart.

suspects.name: Ada Price
suspects.public_description: Ran the bar tonight. Calm, quick with a towel, slow with an answer.
suspects.persona: Ada has worked the bar for ten years. She is loyal to the lodge and distrusts outsiders.
suspects.unrelated_secret: Ada waters down the house whisky and pockets the difference.

states.account: She was behind the bar all night and never left it.

facts.text: The bar was busy from eight until closing.
Bram was in the kitchen most of the evening.

authorised_lies.text: I never left the bar, not once.

states.account: She admits she slipped into the stockroom at ten to fetch a crate, and heard raised voices from the cellar.

facts.text: I went to the stockroom just after ten.
I heard two men arguing in the cellar.

suspects.name: Bram Holt
suspects.public_description: The lodge's cook. Big hands, flour on his sleeves, short temper.
suspects.persona: Bram owes the landlord money and resents him. He is careful to seem helpful.
suspects.voice: Gruff, rambling, changes the subject to food.
suspects.unrelated_secret: Bram is wanted for an unpaid fine in another county.

states.account: He was in the kitchen all night cleaning up after service.

authorised_lies.text: I haven't been down the cellar in a week.

locations.name: The Bar
locations.description: Brass taps, a cold fire, glasses still on the counter.
locations.inspect_text: You run a hand along the counter and check behind the till.

locations.name: The Kitchen
locations.description: Still warm. Pans soaking in the sink.
locations.inspect_text: You go through the drawers and the coat hooks by the back door.

locations.name: The Cellar
locations.description: Barrels, damp stone, a single bulb.
locations.inspect_text: You unlock the cellar door and go down the steps.

evidence.name: Torn stockroom receipt
evidence.description: Half a delivery receipt signed 'A.P.', stamped 22:04, found under the till.
evidence.found_text: Under the till drawer: half a receipt, stamped 22:04.

evidence.name: Cellar key
evidence.description: A heavy iron key on a red string, hung in the cook's coat.
evidence.found_text: In the cook's coat pocket: a heavy iron key on a red string.

evidence.name: Fresh wine stain
evidence.description: A wet red stain on the cellar steps, with a boot print in it.
evidence.found_text: On the third step down: a wet stain and half a boot print.

transitions.reaction: She goes still, folds the towel, and admits the receipt is hers.

hints.text: Someone should look behind the till.

atmospheric_events.text: The lights flicker and die for a moment. Somewhere a door bangs.

solution.motive: He owed the landlord money he could not repay.
solution.method: He struck him with a bottle in the cellar and carried him to the snug.
